description: Estimate a door-to-door domestic intermodal (rail + truck) rate between two U.S. places: drayage to the nearest Class I ramp, the rail line-haul, and drayage from the destination ramp, with the ramps used. Says when a lane has no intermodal service. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

destination.description: Destination city and state, or ZIP. Example: 'Los Angeles, CA'.

origin.description: Origin city and state, or ZIP. Example: 'Chicago, IL'.

name: estimate_intermodal_rate
title: Estimate domestic intermodal rate
